title: Nola and the Puppet Garden

moral: Teamwork lets each person do one job well so the whole story can shine.
summary: Nola cannot wave the mouse and hold the vine at once. Stefan handles the paper garden, Abena keeps the shaker cues, and Nola speaks for the mouse, so the little show works.
